name: scribe
description: Composable skills for reusable Knowledge, company Product and Technical Documentation, professional writing, and technical visuals.

interface.longDescription: Distinguish reusable Knowledge from company Product and Technical Documentation, assess boundaries and authority, structure stable responsibilities and conditional material, and create standard and high-frequency artifacts through explicit skill composition.
defaultPrompt: Use $Ask Scribe to explain which Scribe skills fit my task and return a complete explicit invocation.
Use $Structure Docs to plan a coherent documentation structure and migration map.
Use $Write Doc for a dedicated reader-flow and prose-quality pass on this document.
Use $Reason Domain to assess this reusable Domain Knowledge boundary.
Use $Structure Domain Docs, $Reason Domain, and $Structure Docs to structure this Domain Knowledge set.
Use $Write Domain Doc and $Reason Domain to create the named Domain Knowledge document.
Use $Write Arch Knowledge and $Reason Arch to create reusable Architecture Knowledge.
Use $Reason Product to assess this company portfolio, product line, product, or product responsibility.
Use $Structure Product Docs, $Reason Product, and $Structure Docs to structure this company's Product Documentation Set.
Use $Write Product Doc and $Reason Product to create the named Product Internal Document Type.
Use $Assess Product Lifecycle and $Reason Product to assess the next product decision and artifact coverage.
Use $Reason Tech Docs to assess this company's Technical Landscape and documentation responsibilities.
Use $Structure Tech Docs, $Reason Tech Docs, and $Structure Docs to structure this company's Technical Documentation Set.
Use $Write Tech Doc and $Reason Tech Docs to create the named Technical Internal Document Type.
Use $Write Tech Arch, $Reason Tech Docs, and $Reason Arch to define this company's Technical Architecture.
Use $Draw Diagram to create and verify one useful visual for this document.
